proof_summary: At \(n=473165\), the interior value \(k=a(n)+4=5292270077783\) is odd and greater than 1. A covering of all exponent classes modulo \(48\) shows that every \(k2^m+1\) is divisible by one of \(3,5,7,17,97,257,673\), so it is composite; thus \(k\) is a Sierpiński number strictly between the two proposed consecutive values.
